title: Declare each train's family (behavior or delivery) to match its terminal contract

facts.note: Fires whenever a train definition is authored, edited, reviewed or validated, including unchanged existing definitions under review.
Operation on a train definition; review/validation of an existing unchanged definition activates the rule without any edit.
Planning tasks that create, review, validate, reclassify or renumber trains or change their terminal contracts.
Diff-level observer on train definition fields (family, terminal contract, id), including removals.
Validator finding when the family assertion is missing or disagrees with the terminal contract; can fire on unchanged definitions.

fires: Planner authors a new train definition and must set its family.
Planner adds, changes or removes a train's terminal contract (e.g. to or away from one returning platform:acceptance:commit-receipt), even without touching family.
Planner corrects an existing train's family value, or adds a missing family field, without changing the terminal contract.
Planner reviews or validates existing train definitions that were not edited, and must check each family is present and matches its terminal contract.
Planner proposes or changes train IDs, including a scheme that encodes behavior/delivery as a digit.
doesNotFire: Choosing only the variant category (0-3) of a train without touching, reviewing or validating family, terminal contract or train ID.
Editing wagon or WMBT content that does not change, review or validate any train's terminal contract, family or ID.

given: A train definition exists or is being written: it is authored, edited (family, terminal contract or train ID added, changed or removed), or reviewed/validated even if unchanged.
when: The planner sets, adds or corrects a train's family; adds, changes or removes its terminal contract; proposes or changes a train ID; or reviews/validates existing train definitions.
then: Declare family as delivery if and only if the declared terminal contract requires a durable Acceptance Authority commit and terminates in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt; otherwise declare behavior.
prefer: Derive family from the terminal contract (the source of truth); family is its validator-checked assertion, so re-derive it whenever the terminal contract changes.
behavior: observe, exercise, classify, validate, recommend or report a capability against a system under examination; no authority commit.
delivery: govern accepted-system state through a durable Acceptance Authority commit.
avoid: Encoding family in the train ID (never an ID digit).
Omitting family (mandatory) or treating it as a second source of truth that diverges from the terminal contract.
Inferring family from the variant category (0-3, planner.train.categories) or vice versa; the axes are orthogonal.
why: Behavior trains only exercise a capability; delivery trains change accepted-system state via an authority commit. Deriving family from the terminal contract keeps this checkable and out of IDs and variant categories.
evidence: Validator planner.train.family-matches-terminal-contract passes: every train's family equals the family derived from its declared terminal contract.
Every train definition has a family field with value behavior or delivery.
No train ID encodes the family.
verifier_detail: Derivation: terminal contract requires an Acceptance Authority commit AND terminates in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt => delivery; otherwise => behavior.
Allowed values: behavior | delivery. Schema shape: train -> {family, definition}.
family is mandatory; missing family or mismatch with derived family is a finding (planner.train.family-matches-terminal-contract), checked on all train definitions, not only changed ones.
family is orthogonal to the variant category (planner.train.categories, values 0-3); do not cross-check them against each other.
audit: Source name: Train families; term ids: family (label 'Train families'), family_source_of_truth (label 'Terminal-contract source of truth').
Rationale reference: family and variant as two orthogonal classification axes (see #1083).

splitSuggestion.then: Never encode a train's family in its train ID.

additions.text: The prohibition on encoding family in the train ID is an independent obligation; kept in avoid here, suggested as planner.train.family-not-in-id.

fires/doesNotFire situations and activation facts, including terminal-contract-only additions/changes/removals, family-only corrections, ID-only changes and review/validation of unchanged definitions.
additions.justification: Required by schema; derived from the source's scope (terminal contract as source of truth, mandatory validator-checked family field, no family in IDs).

additions.justification: The full source rationale cites #1083; segment split cut it off.

additions.text: Clarified that the validator check applies to all train definitions, not only changed ones; prefer[0] notes re-derivation on terminal-contract change.
